harper (finance): Quick follow-up from the "delayed tokens" postmortem. We found a brief duplicate-write window that inflated token totals on ~2.2k invoices. Need owners for reprocess, PRs, runbook updates, and customer comms. Short plan + asks below.

alejandra (eng-ml): RCA: during a rolling deploy at 2026-04-12T23:41Z producer-side batching change allowed duplicate publish paths when retries coincided with partition leadership changes. Dedup relied on batch_id which collided across instances for ~5m. Repro script uploaded.

sam (eng-sre): Containment actions: disabled the alternate publisher at 23:49Z PT and paused invoice finalization. No new duplicates after that. Created incident tickets and uploaded the affected-accounts CSV.

billing-bot: Created BIL-6219: "duplicate-publish-reconcile" and linked to INC-90500. Affected CSV: s3://incidents/INC-90500/affected.csv

harper (finance): Action items (please ack with ETAs):
- @ivy (platform): own reprocess pipeline + validation run (48h)
- @alejandra (eng-ml): patch producer dedupe key + tests (48h)
- @sam (eng-sre): rollout playbook + invoice-freeze/unfreeze checklist (24h)
- @chris (support): draft customer messaging (EOD)
Finance will coordinate credits after verification.

ivy (platform): Reprocess outline: 1) select invoices where COUNT(events) > 1 and ABS(delta) > 75 in the event window; 2) replay events with idempotent dedupe; 3) produce reconciliation CSV for finance; 4) apply atomic invoice patches. Staging dry-run first. SQL I'll run in staging:

```sql
SELECT account_id, invoice_id, SUM(token_delta) AS replay_tokens, COUNT(*) AS ev_count
FROM metering_events
WHERE ingested_at BETWEEN '2026-04-12 23:35:00' AND '2026-04-12 23:50:00'
GROUP BY account_id, invoice_id
HAVING ev_count > 1 AND ABS(replay_tokens) > 75
LIMIT 3000;
```

I'll post the staging reconciliation diff before any prod change.

alejandra (eng-ml): I'll open PR for the producer change in ~4h. Plan: include producer_instance_uuid + partition_window in batch key and add an integration test simulating producer restarts and retries. Also adding metric metering.publish_duplicate_rate and alert at 0.02% over 5m.

sam (eng-sre): Rollout ops: prefer 01:00-02:00 PT window, FF-first canary on 5% of partitions, validate consumer lag=0 and reconciliation dry-run success before unfreezing invoices. I'll add a runbook step to prevent parallel re-ingest while reprocess runs.

chris (support): Drafting comms now: brief incident notice + option for manual account remediation. Will post templates to #support-drafts by 17:30 PT.

billing-bot: Note: Created BIL-6220 to "hold-auto-invoice" until BIL-6219 verification. Linked tickets to INC-90500.

harper (finance): Please ACK with final ETAs in-thread. I'll run a 20m check-in tomorrow 09:00 PT and schedule the retro after reconciliation completes.

ivy (platform): ACK. Dry-run in staging within 48h, will share validation checklist.

alejandra (eng-ml): ACK. PR ping in ~4h.

sam (eng-sre): ACK. Runbook update + rollout plan in 6h.

chris (support): ACK. Templates posted by EOD.

harper (finance): Thanks everyone. Final ask: keep the affected CSV revisions in the ticket and avoid emailing customers until finance approves wording. I'll post progress here tomorrow 09:00 PT. :white_check_mark:
